description: This file defines API endpoints for file management in a FastAPI application. It includes functionalities to list, upload, and delete files associated with user sessions, integrating with Supabase for storage and database operations. The code enforces allowed file types and size limits, handles storage and metadata consistency, and ensures user authorization.

methods.name: Client get_supabase()
methods.description: Creates and returns a Supabase client using environment variables for configuration.

methods.name: str _ext(name: str)
methods.description: Extracts the file extension from a filename, returning it in lowercase (including the dot).

methods.name: list_files(session_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter files by session ID"), user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves a list of files for the current user, optionally filtered by session ID.

methods.name: upload_file( session_id: str = Form(..., description="Target session ID"), upload: UploadFile = File(..., description="File to upload (.docx, .pdf, .txt, .xlsx)"), user=Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Handles uploading a file for a session, validating file type and size, storing the file in Supabase Storage, and inserting metadata into the database.

methods.name: delete_file(file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Deletes a file and its storage object if owned by the current user.

methods.name: delete_session_file(session_id: str, file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Deletes a file associated with a specific session, verifying ownership and session association.

ctags.name: list_files
ctags.pattern: /^def list_files(session_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter files by session ID")/
ctags.signature: (session_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter files by session ID"), user=Depends(get_current_user))
